title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, naming MD5 (createHashs*(s*['"]md5['"]) requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The javascript-specific remedy is selecting createHash('sha256').
applicability: javascript codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
